As our Webflow & Visual Specialist, you’ll work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team to continuously build and improve Lio’s website. You’ll turn concepts and Figma designs into polished, responsive web experiences, while also bringing a strong visual eye to everything we put out.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys the intersection of web building, design, and technology and likes turning ideas into things that actually go live.

We’re open to both full-time candidates and freelancers for this role.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Build, launch, and continuously improve Lio’s website in Webflow or Framer

  • Work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team to turn ideas and Figma designs into polished web experiences

  • Build new landing pages, campaign pages, and other web experiences from concept to launch

  • Create responsive layouts, interactions, and animations that make the website feel polished across devices

  • Help maintain and improve the structure, components, and consistency of our website as it grows

  • Turn complex ideas around AI and enterprise technology into simple and engaging digital experiences

  • Create visuals and assets for our website, social media, campaigns, events, and other brand touchpoints

  • Experiment with new tools, interactions, and web technologies to continuously improve Lio’s digital presence


Your Profile

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly comfortable building and shipping websites in Webflow or Framer

  • Are proficient in Figma and can confidently translate designs into responsive, production-ready pages

  • Understand responsive design, components, interactions, animations, and the fundamentals of modern web experiences

  • Have a strong visual eye for typography, layout, spacing, and composition

  • Can take a rough idea or Figma concept and turn it into a polished live experience

  • Enjoy both the creative and technical sides of building for the web

  • Care about the details and like figuring out how to make things work, not just how they should look

  • Learn new tools quickly and enjoy experimenting with new technologies

  • Feel comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating closely with others

Your experience can come from professional, freelance, or personal projects — what matters most to us is what you can build.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with motion design and web animations

  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript

  • Experience with custom code or integrations in Webflow or Framer


Why Join Us?

At Lio, you’ll help build the next category-defining AI company from the ground up. You’ll work closely with our Founding Brand Operator, CEO, and GTM team and see the things you build go live quickly.

You’ll have plenty of room to experiment with new tools and ideas, develop your skills, and make a visible impact on how Lio shows up online.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description

Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package.

The Senior Sales Manager will play a key role in growing Checkout.com’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Desire an independent, high-achieving individual that stands out in an entrepreneurial environment and has the grit and desire to outperform sales targets.

How you’ll make impact:
● Acting as a consultative Payments strategist able to advise companies on an optimal payments structure that pulls from a myriad of solutions Checkout.com provides
● Identify, qualify and close the most promising prospects and partners that will help Checkout.com grow a healthy pipeline across various verticals.
● Build prospect engagement strategies and partner with marketing, business development, product and other departments to build qualified that pipeline in cold and warm channels
● Pitch our next-generation payment solutions and value-added services
● Prepare high-quality presentations and proposals for C-suite stakeholders at prospective merchants, and implement winning negotiation strategies
● Become the expert on Checkout.com’s technology stack, help new merchants understand the value of Checkout.com to solve their pain points, and handle detailed questions about our product capabilities.
● Orchestrate the entire Sales process, drive urgency and work to mutual action plans, and act as the main point of contact for merchants and internal stakeholders.
● Maintain a solid, well-organized portfolio and nurture key accounts by having a deep understanding of their industry, pain points, and needs.
● Partner with other Payment Sales Managers to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends.
● Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information.

Qualifications:
● 3+ years Enterprise Sales experience directly in the Payments industry
● Track record of high performance, and self sourcing leads
● Highly motivated and committed to growth and development with excellent communication skills
● Solid network of potential prospects and partners within the payments landscape
● Tech-savvy, with a passion for Fintech and Payments
● Strong commercial acumen, ability to effectively negotiate complex structures

● Fluent in English + German

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.description:
DAS IST DER JOB

Du möchtest Produkte erschaffen, die durchdachtes Design und echten Impact für unseren Planeten verbinden? Bei everdrop vereinst du als Industrial Product Designer & Engineer – Home Accessories (m/w/d) Ästhetik mit technischer Konstruktion. Du übernahmst die Verantwortung für unser Produktportfolio – von der ersten Idee über die CAD-Entwicklung bis hin zur Serienreife.

Dies werden deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Du entwickelst hochwertige und clevere Haushalts-Produkte von der ersten Produktidee bis zur Serienreife – mit Fokus auf Design, Funktionalität und Nachhaltigkeit.

  • Du konstruierst Produkte eigenständig und entwickelst technische Lösungen, die durch intelligente Funktionen und eine hervorragende User Experience überzeugen.

  • Du wählst geeignete Materialien und Fertigungsverfahren aus und optimierst Produkte hinsichtlich Qualität, Nachhaltigkeit, Herstellbarkeit und Kosten.

  • Du steuerst internationale Lieferanten und Entwicklungspartner, stimmst technische Details ab und stellst eine reibungslose und effiziente Umsetzung sicher.

  • Du arbeitest eng vernetzt mit Produktmanagement, Procurement und Operations zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Produkt-Vision ein außergewöhnliches Serienprodukt wird.


DAS BIST DU

Wenn du dich leidenschaftlich für Nachhaltigkeit engagieren möchtest und hochmotiviert bist, mit uns die Welt ein bisschen sauberer zu machen, dann finden wir dich richtig gut!

Wenn du außerdem gerne proaktiv und im Team arbeitest, und du jede kleine und große Herausforderung als eine Chance ansiehst, noch besser zu werden – dann sind wir schon ein ganz kleines bisschen verknallt.

Wenn du schließlich auch noch über die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen verfügst, dann sind wir uns fast sicher: Das könnte der Beginn einer ganz großen Love Story sein!

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Industriedesign, Produktentwicklung, Maschinenbau, Konstruktion oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung physischer Konsumgüter mit – idealerweise im Bereich Home & Living, Haushaltsprodukte oder Consumer Goods.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für hochwertiges Produktdesign und kannst dieses mit technischer Machbarkeit verbinden.

  • Du kennst und verstehst unterschiedliche Herstellprozesse bzw. relevante Fertigungsverfahren (wie Spritzguss, Extrusion oder CNC) und die entsprechenden Materialien (wie Kunststoffe, Silikon, Holz oder Metall) und kannst das Wissen bereits in der Konzeption einfließen lassen.

  • Du verstehst Herstellkosten, Zielkosten und Wirtschaftlichkeit und entwickelst Produkte, die technisch und kommerziell überzeugen.

  • Du beherrschst CAD-Programme (z. B. SolidWorks oder Fusion 360) und konstruierst Produkte eigenständig.

  • Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Englisch und hast idealerweise Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Herstellern und Lieferanten.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast den Anspruch, aus guten Ideen außergewöhnliche Produkte zu machen.

DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎


Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • abwechslungsreiche, sinnstiftende und Purpose-getriebene Arbeit

  • großartiger Teamgeist und regelmäßige Team-Events 

  • ein wunderschönes, helles, geräumiges Büro in der Nähe der Isar

  • eine Outdoor-Fitnessanlage neben dem Büro 

  • Special Rate für EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und JobRad

  • ein monatlicher Gutschein für everdrop Produkte in unserem Mitarbeitershop

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft bei FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • mobiles Arbeiten für 20 Tage pro Jahr innerhalb der EU möglich

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub plus 24.12. und 31.12. frei

  • zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)

  • dein eigenes MacBook, solange du bei everdrop arbeitest

Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Bei everdrop wollen wir eine Kultur der Inklusion, Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit leben. Das Commitment, die Welt ein bisschen besser zu machen, ist Teil unseres alltäglichen Handelns. Vor allem wollen wir das Bewusstsein für unseren Planeten und für andere Menschen fördern.

Ein Beispiel dafür, wie wir am Arbeitsplatz Awareness schaffen möchten: Menstruierende Kolleg*innen, die unter Schmerzen leiden, können ganz einfach einen oder mehrere "Power Days" nehmen, zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage. jobs.title: Nachtverpleegkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
jobs.description:
Als nachtverpleegkundige bij Seniorplaza krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten binnen een multidisciplinair team. Je volgt bewoners op, denkt mee en bouwt een sterke zorgrelatie op. Je bent een baken van rust in de nacht en blinkt uit in het bewaren van de rust. Je zorgt voor de verbinding tussen nacht en dag en brieft je collega's zodat deze aan een vlotte werkshift kunnen beginnen.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit volgens de geldende richtlijnen;
  • je coördineert en bewaakt het zorgplan van bewoners;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen in gezondheidstoestand;
  • je ondersteunt en begeleidt zorgkundigen;
  • je bereid de werking van de volgende dagshift voor;
  • je voert administratieve taken uit in functie van kwalitatieve zorg.

Als nachtverpleegkundige draag je bij aan verpleegkundige handelingen, zorgplanning, opvolging van zorgtrajecten en begeleiding van zorgkundigen. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor persoonsgerichte, kwalitatieve zorg met een sterke band met bewoners en familie. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten klinisch inzicht, communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je coördineert, observeert, beslissingen onderbouwt en als aanspreekpunt fungeert.

Verder vragen wij:

  • professionele bachelor verpleegkunde of HBO5 + visum;
  • ervaring: niet vereist (wel een plus);
  • sterk in zorgplan opvolgen, rapporteren en samenwerken multidisciplinair;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel, stressbestendig en een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

jobs.title: Verzorgende Thuiszorg - Regio Roeselare - vervanging tot einde van jaar
jobs.description:
Als medewerker gezinszorg in onze dienst gezins- en bejaardenhulp help je bejaarden, mensen met een handicap en zorgbehoevenden thuis met de huishoudelijke taken. Afhankelijk van de situatie neemt de verzorgende een aantal taken geheel of gedeeltelijk over. Tot jouw taken behoren bijvoorbeeld: strijken, wassen, koken, boodschappen doen, administratieve verrichtingen, oppas, lichaamsverzorging, kinderopvang, ...

 

Als verzorgende help je zorgbehoevende thuis om zo zelfstandig, comfortabel en veilig mogelijk te wonen. Je ondersteunt hen bij huishoudelijke taken, boodschappen, administratie en persoonlijke verzorging. Je werkt met respect en oog voor de wensen van elke cliënt, en past je aanpak aan op wat zij nodig hebben. Sociaal inzicht, zelfstandigheid en nauwkeurigheid zorgen ervoor dat je je werk professioneel en met plezier uitvoert.

Je bent betrokken, betrouwbaar en kan goed plannen. Met jouw praktische aanpak en gevoel voor kwaliteit maak je echt het verschil in het dagelijks leven van je cliënten.

Functie-eisen:

Diploma in een zorgrichting (bijvoorbeeld verzorgende of zorgkundige);
Zelfstandig en planmatig kunnen werken;
In het bezit van een wagen
Zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands omdat je met mensen moet kunnen communiceren want zijn steeds aanwezig;

jobs.title: Poetshulp Thuiszorg - Regio Willebroek
jobs.description:
Als medewerker van onze poetsdienst bied je ondersteuning aan zorgbehoevenden die, omwille van gezondheidsredenen, niet meer zelf kunnen instaan voor het onderhoud van hun woning. Je draagt bij aan een nette, hygiënische en aangename leefomgeving bij de zorgbehoevende thuis, wat een groot verschil maakt in hun dagelijks leven.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden zijn:

  • je maakt de woning schoon (stofzuigen, dweilen, afstoffen en algemeen onderhoud);
  • je reinigt keuken en sanitair en zorgt voor hygiëne en orde;
  • je maakt bedden op en ververst lakens volgens afspraak;
  • je helpt bij opruimen en het ordelijk houden van leefruimtes;
  • je verlucht kamers en draagt bij aan een frisse woonomgeving;
  • je doet afwas en bergt de vaat op indien dit binnen het takenpakket valt;
  • je werkt discreet en respectvol, met aandacht voor de gewoontes van de cliënt.

Voor deze functie van Poetshulp verwachten wij van jou:

  • Motivatie maar geen specifiek diploma;
  • Dat je betrouwbaar en respectvol bent;
  • Dat je een hart hebt voor zorgbehoevenden;
  • Dat je zelfstandig kan werken en initiatief toont;
  • Een flexibele, gedreven en sociaal voelende ingesteldheid;
  • Dat je over een wagen beschikt.

jobs.title: (Zelfstandig) thuisverpleegkundige – regio Berchem
jobs.description:
Heb jij het hart op de juiste plek en wil je zelfstandig werken met impact? Dan ben jij de thuisverpleegkundige die we zoeken!

Als (zelfstandig) thuisverpleegkundige bied je kwalitatieve en persoonlijke zorg aan cliënten in hun vertrouwde omgeving. Je werkt autonoom, maar steeds in nauwe samenwerking met andere zorgverleners.

Bij ons doe je écht mee:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit zoals wondzorg, inspuitingen en medicatietoediening;
  • je schat de zorgbehoefte van cliënten in (klinisch, psychisch en sociaal);
  • je stelt zorgplannen op en volgt deze op;
  • je observeert de gezondheidstoestand van cliënten en stuurt bij waar nodig;
  • je registreert zorg en houdt patiëntendossiers correct bij;
  • je overlegt met huisartsen en andere zorgprofessionals;
  • je begeleidt cliënten en mantelzorgers en stimuleert zelfredzaamheid.

Je wordt voornamelijk ingezet in de regio Berchem afhankelijk van jouw mobiliteit.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar bent altijd verbonden met een betrokken team en organisatie die jou ondersteunt.

Klinkt dat als jouw manier van werken? Join ons netwerk!

Ben jij een (zelfstandige) verpleegkundige met een hart voor zorg? Dan pas je perfect bij ons.

  • Je beschikt over een diploma verpleegkunde en een RIZIV-nummer;
  • Je bent bereid je te conventioneren;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hecht ook belang aan samenwerking;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk, nauwkeurig en betrouwbaar;
  • Je communiceert vlot met cliënten, mantelzorgers en zorgpartners;
  • Je bouwt sterke relaties op met huisartsen en andere zorgverleners;
  • Je denkt mee in het belang van de patiënt en stimuleert zelfzorg;
  • Je kan je vinden in een mensgerichte zorgvisie zoals Positive Care;
  • Nederlands spreken en begrijpen? Helemaal in orde.

jobs.title: Zorgkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
jobs.description:
Bij Seniorplaza draag je als zorgkundige bij aan een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat. Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor bewoners en maakt het verschil in kleine momenten van aandacht. Je werkt nauw samen met verpleegkundigen en collega’s om kwaliteitsvolle, persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert gedelegeerde verzorgende en verpleegkundige handelingen uit;
  • je staat in voor dagelijkse verzorging en hygiëne;
  • je biedt comfortzorg en preventieve zorg;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen;
  • je ondersteunt bij maaltijden, medicatie en dagelijkse activiteiten;
  • je draagt bij aan orde en netheid op de afdeling.

Als zorgkundige draag je bij aan dagelijkse verzorging, hygiëne, comfortzorg en preventieve zorg, met aandacht voor orde en netheid op de afdeling. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat, elke dag opnieuw. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten betrokkenheid, nauwkeurigheid en teamgerichtheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je kwaliteitsvol werkt, veranderingen observeert en samen met verpleegkundigen de zorg afstemt.

Verder vragen wij: 

  • diploma en visum zorgkundige;
  • ervaring: niet vereist;
  • correct uitvoeren van gedelegeerde handelingen + observeren/rapporteren;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel en stressbestendig.

jobs.title: Regioverantwoordelijke Provincie Antwerpen flex / huisbezoeker
jobs.description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke flex zorg je mee voor de continuïteit van de werking binnen thuiszorg in de provincie Antwerpen. Je springt in waar het druk is of waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is, en je ondersteunt teams vanuit ons kantoor in Willebroek. Je combineert organisatie en people management met een mensgerichte aanpak: je motiveert medewerkers, bewaakt planningen en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Dankzij jouw overzicht blijft de dienstverlening betrouwbaar en goed afgestemd op de klant.

Jouw dagelijkse taken zijn:

  • je zorgt mee voor de continuïteit van onze werking gezinszorg/poetsdienst waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is of waar het extra druk is;
  • je maakt planningen op en volgt verlof, bezetting en inzetbaarheid op voor een team van 30-35 medewerkers;
  • je voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit en afstemming van de dienstverlening;
  • je voert gesprekken met medewerkers rond functioneren, welbevinden en ontwikkeling;
  • je motiveert, enthousiasmeert en stuurt bij waar nodig, met aandacht voor teamdynamiek;
  • je speelt in op noden en wensen van cliënten vanuit het volledige aanbod van Korian Home Care;
  • je onderhoudt contacten met medewerkers, cliënten en doorverwijzers;
  • je volgt opleiding en inwerktrajecten vanuit de kantoren in Willebroek.

Als regioverantwoordelijke flex draag je bij aan de continuïteit van de gezinszorg of poetsdienst binnen jouw regio. Je maakt planningen op, ondersteunt medewerkers, voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit van dienstverlening. Je motiveert teams en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een betrouwbare en mensgerichte dienstverlening. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten organisatorisch sterk, communicatief en mensgericht binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je teams aanstuurt en dienstverlening op elkaar afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • je beschikt over minimaal een bachelor diploma (bij voorkeur zorg gerelateerd);
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en initiatief nemen;
  • je bent flexibel en betrokken;
  • je kan zeer goed plannen en denkt oplossingsgericht;
  • je beschikt over een rijbewijs en eigen wagen;
  • je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk).

Jij helpt hen om in een nette, veilige en aangename thuisomgeving te blijven wonen. Je werkt zelfstandig bij mensen thuis en zorgt met jouw hulp voor comfort, rust en meer levenskwaliteit in het dagelijks leven. Jouw nieuwe taken:

Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen draag je bij aan comfort en zelfstandigheid van cliënten in hun eigen woning. Je helpt met huishoudelijke taken zodat mensen veilig en aangenaam thuis kunnen blijven wonen. Samen met je cliënten zorg jij voor netheid, rust en een verzorgde thuisomgeving. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten zelfstandig, betrouwbaar en sociaal voelend binnen jouw functie centraal. jobs.title: Maatschappelijk werker - Dienst Tewerkstelling
jobs.employer: Openbaar Centrum voor Maatschappelijk Welzijn van Willebroek OCMW
jobs.description:
Wil je je dagdagelijks inzetten voor burgers in een sociaal-kwetsbare situatie en hen sterker maken in onze samenleving? Kan je mensen inspireren en activeren? Dan hebben wij een job voor jou.

Als Maatschappelijk Werker binnen de Dienst Tewerkstelling speel je een cruciale rol in het begeleiden en ondersteunen van cliënten naar een geschikte plek op de arbeidsmarkt. Je werkt met verschillende doelgroepen, waaronder langdurig werkzoekenden, nieuwkomers, mensen met een beperking en jongeren. Je helpt hen bij het vinden van werk, opleiding of een traject dat hen naar de arbeidsmarkt brengt.

  • Begeleiden en coachen van cliënten in hun zoektocht naar werk.
  • Opstellen van individuele trajectplannen gericht op arbeidsintegratie.
  • Helpen bij het herkennen en ontwikkelen van talenten en vaardigheden.
  • Ondersteunen bij sollicitatieprocessen, zoals het opstellen van CV’s en motivatiebrieven.
  • Samenwerken met werkgevers, scholen en opleidingsinstituten om werkervaringsplekken en stages te creëren.
  • Voorzien van informatie en advies over opleidingen, bijscholingen en mogelijkheden binnen de lokale arbeidsmarkt.
  • Signaleren van knelpunten en doorverwijzen naar de juiste instanties indien nodig.
  • Rapporteren over de voortgang van de trajecten en vastleggen van begeleidingsgegevens.

  • Je hebt een bachelordiploma sociaal werk, orthopedagogie, gezinswetenschappen of sociale re-adaptatiewetenschappen op zak.

  • Je bent bij voorkeur in het bezit van een rijbewijs B.
  • Je bent empathisch, klantgericht, outreachend, discreet en bezit een grote dosis verantwoordelijkheidszin.
  • Je kan je werk goed organiseren en zelfstandig werken.
  • Administratie en continue bijscholing schrikken je niet af.
  • Je schriftelijke communicatie is helder en gestructureerd. Verslaggeving maakt een cruciaal deel uit van je job.
  • Je kan omgaan met de nodige werkdruk

jobs.title: Bestrater
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren bestrater die nauwkeurig werk levert, ook in uitdagende omgevingen? Als Bestrater voer je zorgvuldig herstellingen uit na technische grondwerken, met een focus op kwaliteit en afwerking.

Jouw taken?

  • Herstellen van voetpaden, fietspaden en bestrating na technische ingrepen;
  • Zorgvuldig terugplaatsen van kasseien, klinkers en natuursteen op diverse locaties;

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Azure Cloud Engineer 

Our client is looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to strengthen its Application Engineering Team and support the expansion of its Azure cloud capabilities. The team currently consists of cloud engineers, architects, a Product Owner, and a Team Lead, and plays a key role within the IT Foundation organization.The successful candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, operation, and optimization of secure and scalable Azure cloud environments while promoting Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain Azure-based cloud solutions.
  • Support cloud-native applications and infrastructure deployments.
  • Ensure platform availability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Develop and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code solutions using Bicep and Terraform.
  • Contribute to automation initiatives and CI/CD integration.
  • Promote standardization through modular and maintainable deployments.

Networking & Security

  • Manage and optimize Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Firewalls, Gateways, and Load Balancers.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security best practices.
  • Support Identity & Access Management using Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM.
  • Contribute to Zero Trust and Azure Policy implementations.

Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor cloud environments and optimize performance and costs.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues.
  • Improve operational maturity, reliability, and governance practices.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, developers, security teams, and business stakeholders.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Bicep).
  • Solid understanding of Azure networking and cloud security.
  • Experience with Azure Container Apps (ACA) and containerized workloads.
  • Experience with Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Verified Modules.
  • Experience with container orchestration and management.
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, or security-related certifications.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Team player with a collaborative approach.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Success Factors

  • Deliver secure, scalable, and reliable Azure solutions.
  • Maintain high-quality and reusable IaC assets.
  • Foster collaboration between IT, development, and business teams.
  • Build trust through transparency, consistency, and proactive communication.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 – $195,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Account Executive, Existing Business
Software Engineer II
Senior Product Manager - AI
Director, Mobility Partnerships
jobs.description:
Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank's expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.

You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank's representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction.

This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.

What you'll do

  • Build Material Bank's founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine.
  • Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution.
  • Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community.
  • Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers.
  • Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights.
  • Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank's strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business.
  • Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors.
  • Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders.
  • A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach.
  • Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders.
  • Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows.
  • Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America.
  • A passion for innovation and the future of mobility design.

Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. Our powerful material database and proprietary robotic distribution facility allow members to order samples to be delivered free of charge overnight.Material Bank was founded by Adam Sandow in 2018 and has deeply transformed how the Architecture and Design industry works in the United States. It's an exciting time for the company - Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart. Candidates who join us will have the unique opportunity to define, build, and shape our European business.

Material Bank uses your information to process your current application and offer you job opportunities in the future. You have the right to access, rectify, and erase this information, as well as to limit its use or object to it and give directives on its fate after your death. For more information, please consult our privacy policy: https://www.materialbank.eu/privacy-policy

 

What you'll get from us:

  • Our people: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.
  • Relaxation and Celebrations: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). 
  • Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program. 
  • Plan for your Retirement: 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed!
  • Giving Back: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities. 
  • Growth: We'll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters! 
  • Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid  working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.  

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Group Account Director ( Maternity cover)
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Group Account Director ( Maternity cover)

Location:  London, England, United Kingdom

 

About the role: 

As Group Account Director, you'll lead the strategic, creative, and commercial performance of your client portfolio — owning the client relationship from senior stakeholder engagement through to studio delivery. You'll oversee two studio teams, integrate with client-side organisations while maintaining top-tier agency standards, and be accountable for growth, profitability, and the quality of everything that goes out the door. This is a role for a seasoned account leader who can think strategically, act decisively, and bring teams and clients along with them.

What you will be doing: 

  • Client Leadership & Strategic Partnership
    • Act as the senior point of contact for a portfolio of two to three clients, building trusted, high-value relationships with client partners at Head of Marketing and Marketing Director level.
    • Collaborate closely with client stakeholders to define and execute marketing strategy and activity — translating their business objectives into effective, ambitious creative solutions.
    • Champion brand guardianship across all client projects, ensuring the client experience is consistently exceptional and creative output meets the highest standards.
    • Be present at client offices two to three days per week, maintaining active, face-to-face engagement and seamless communication across all workstreams.
    • Present creative and strategic work with confidence and clarity to senior client and OLIVER stakeholders, including client SLT.
    • Anticipate client needs, proactively identify creative and strategic opportunities, and negotiate win-win outcomes on behalf of the team.
  • Studio Leadership & Delivery
    • Oversee two studio teams — on and offshore — ensuring seamless integration with clients' businesses and consistent delivery against briefs, timelines, and quality standards.
    • Serve as the single escalation point for internal and client SLA breaches or process gaps — capturing issues and working with the Business Director and Managing Partner to resolve them.
    • Own the execution of projects, run rates, and client satisfaction through regular WIP management and catch-ups with job owners.
    • Work with the OLIVER Hub on ad-hoc project requests, ensuring smooth coordination across the wider network.
    • Lead, manage, and develop junior team members — fostering a culture of ambition, accountability, and continuous improvement.
    • Be willing to work at every level of the operation: one moment presenting to client SLT, the next trafficking campaigns to keep work moving.
  • Commercial Accountability & Growth
    • Take full financial ownership of your accounts — including profitability, accuracy of forecasting, fee negotiation, and management of late payment.
    • Provide regular, timely financial reporting to the Business Director, with clear visibility of account performance against targets.
    • Be accountable for the delivery of growth targets across the portfolio.
    • Identify and develop new business opportunities through client relationships, introducing Brandtech Group capabilities where relevant and appropriate.

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A proven track record of leading senior client relationships in a fast-paced, multi-discipline agency or in-house environment — working independently without the support of a large account structure.
  • Exceptional client engagement skills — proactive, influential, and able to build strong, trusted working relationships with senior marketing stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen: experience owning account P&L, managing profitability, negotiating fees, and delivering against growth targets.
  • Experience leading and developing studio or agency teams, with the confidence to work across every level of the operation.
  • A genuine understanding of creative excellence — you can champion the work, provide sound creative direction, and generate ideas that practically contribute to output.
  • Deep knowledge of digital and performance marketing, with strong understanding of paid media channels — particularly LinkedIn and PPC.
  • Experience managing TUPE-sensitive transitions and leading teams through organisational change with clarity and care.
  • First-rate communication and presentation skills — clear, articulate, and naturally able to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of OLIVER and IIG Group capabilities, and how to deploy them to clients' commercial advantage.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related software.
  • Comfortable working in a hybrid environment with regular in-office presence to support team cohesion and client engagement.
  • Oversee annual studio or account-level budgets across the portfolio — tracking spend, driving cost efficiencies, and presenting financial performance to client and OLIVER stakeholders.
  • Accountable for the financial health, profitability, and commercial growth of the accounts in your portfolio.
  • Experience leading fee negotiations and managing commercial frameworks with senior clients.
  • Strategic integration of Gen AI tools across studio projects, client workflows, and operational processes.
  • Experience setting AI quality standards and governance at studio or account level, and embedding responsible AI use across teams.
  • Agentic leadership for complex, multi-team business and creative challenges — you take a systematic approach to ambiguous problems and create clear paths to resolution.
  • Drives AI innovation and best practice sharing across your teams and the wider OLIVER network.
  • Confident guiding both clients and colleagues on the responsible, effective use of AI in marketing and creative production.
  • Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience — gained through work, self-directed learning, or other routes — counts equally.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Spire:

Spire Global is a leading provider of space-based data, analytics, and services, helping organizations make better decisions with insights from our constellation of satellites. We are committed to operational excellence, compliance, and maintaining the highest standards of internal control.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical outcome of complex space missions. During mission contracting and requirements development, you may work with the sales engineering org to ensure mission requirements are valid and mission scope is adequately defined. Systems Engineers translate higher level requirements down to lower-level requirements, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.  

You will be the overall technical lead responsible for "building the right thing" and "building it right". This will include the management of system requirements, technical budgets, and sub-system interfaces.  Your responsibility extends to ensuring there is sufficient verification and testing of the system, and you will take ownership of the technical performance outcomes for the mission. You will be the mission's technical lead for both Spire-internal and external (customer, contractor, etc) teams, working collaboratively with others to resolve technical discrepancies in requirements, specifications, or system performance. 

You will also act as the technical point of contact for Spire's global customers during mission development phases and through on-orbit validation of the space systems, working with Spire project and program managers to provide effective communication where required. 

Your knowledge and experience working across multiple technical disciplines will help you coordinate Spire's technical efforts to ensure ultimate mission success. 

Role Responsibilities:

  • Take overall technical ownership of Spire Space and/or Ground Systems from technical development through on-orbit verification; ensure that we are "building the right thing" and "building it right".
  • Lead requirements management for a given mission or program - including development, validation, verification, and change management.
  • Lead technical risk management for a given mission or program - including identification, qualification, mitigation, and resolution.
  • Develop top-level requirements and then flow-down to lower-levels, consulting and collaborating with discipline team-leads and subject matter experts where necessary.
  • Serve as the primary Spire technical POC to customers and contractors - communicating and advocating on behalf of internal technical teams where necessary.
  • Serve as the customer's technical representative to Spire-internal teams - communicating and sometimes advocating for customer requirements, expectations, and experiences.
  • Develop working knowledge of Spire's satellite platforms, operations systems, and payloads (both Spire and customer-developed) - including customer APIs and software service interfaces.
  • Proactively communicate to program/project managers where changes in scope, requirements, expected system performance, or development outcomes impact the mission.
  • Develop, deliver, and maintain mission documentation required to support programs or missions, including both internal and external (customer- or contractor-facing) documentation.
  • Support the sales engineering team in the development of technical concepts and budgets, feasibility assessments, requirements, scope, and documentation needed during the sales cycle.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, equivalent STEM-related subject, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience working in a technical engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, RF Communications, etc) or as a systems engineer for complex integrated systems.
  • Comprehensive understanding of space systems, concepts of operations, and remote systems operation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as a space systems engineer working across engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Controls, Radio/Comms, etc)
  • Experience developing or integrating RF and optical payloads.
  • Experience participating in architecture and design of digital systems including ground station networks, data distribution and data processing systems, and spacecraft data handling systems
  • Experience coordinating or leading diverse technical teams spanning multiple engineering disciplines and time zones
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with clients and effectively communicating with other members of cross-functional teams
  • Strong comprehension skills to enable timely understanding of complex customer requirements and identification of thorough and sometimes unique solutions
  • Experience in satellite mission design, development, and testing with a clear understanding of major mission design trades and scope drivers (power / payload duty cycle, communications systems / data budgets, ground stations, launch and environmental loads, EMI/EMC, thermal management, etc.)

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1

 


Global Perks

🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.

jobs.title: Employee Relations Specialist - 12 Month FTC
jobs.description:
About us

We are champions of rail, inspired to build a greener, more sustainable future of travel. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

Now Europe’s number 1 downloaded rail app, with over 135 million monthly visits and £6.3 billion in annual ticket sales, we collaborate with 270+ rail and coach companies in over 40 countries. We want to create a world where travel is as simple, seamless, eco-friendly and affordable as it should be. 

Today, we're a FTSE 250 company driven by our incredible team of over 1,000 Trainliners from 50+ nationalities, based across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. With our focus on growth in the UK and Europe, now is the perfect time to join us on this high-speed journey. 

Introducing the Trainline People Team 👋

Our People team is here to make Trainline a great place to work, and employee relations sits right at the heart of that. As our Employee Relations Specialist, you'll be the go-to expert for ER casework across the business on a 12-month fixed term contract, owning cases end-to-end and giving managers the confident, practical guidance they need at every stage, from a tricky conversation to a formal investigation.

You'll work closely with line managers, HR Business Partners and the wider People team, building the templates, toolkits and processes that help us handle ER consistently and efficiently as we grow. This is a role for someone who takes real pride in getting ER right, both for the business and for the individual, and who's excited by the chance to streamline and modernise how we manage casework administration.

In this role as the Employee Relations Specialist, you will... 🚄

  • Own and manage a varied caseload of employee relations matters, including disciplinaries, grievances, capability processes, absence management and settlement agreements, from initial scoping through to resolution.

  • Lead formal investigations, including planning investigation scope, conducting interviews, gathering evidence and producing clear, objective investigation reports.

  • Chair or support formal hearings, such as disciplinary, grievance, capability and appeal hearings, and prepare the accompanying outcome documentation.

  • Apply the ACAS Code of Practice and current UK employment law consistently, ensuring every case reflects Trainline's policies and standards.

  • Manage cases involving trade union representatives with professionalism and care, drawing on a solid understanding of collective employee relations obligations.

  • Provide practical, confident advice to line managers and HR Business Partners, coaching them to build their own capability in handling employee relations matters.

  • Spot patterns across casework and flag emerging or systemic issues to the People leadership team.

  • Own case administration and documentation, including letters, scripts, file notes and case trackers, while identifying opportunities to streamline and automate our employee relations processes.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Identity & Access Management | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, group, account, consent and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

 

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Ship Features, Not Just Code: You will own the implementation of end-to-end features. You won't just write functions in isolation; you will ensure your code solves the actual user problem, works in production, and is covered by robust tests.

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams. You will actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to shared standards. You aren't afraid to ask for help, but you also aren't afraid to challenge a design if you think there is a better way.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: You will use AI-assisted tools (like Copilot and Claude) to handle boilerplate and refactoring, allowing you to focus on logic and product value. We value engineers who use the best tools to ship faster.

  • Build for Quality: You will write well-tested, production-ready code that your future self (and your team) will thank you for. You understand that "speed" doesn't mean "sloppy"—it means building reliable software that doesn't break at 2am. You will participate in incident response, learn from postmortems, and help the team continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

 

Qualities we look for

  • Ownership and Reliability: You take responsibility for what you ship. You write tests, monitor your code in production, and follow through when things go wrong. You're proactive about flagging issues and asking for help when you need it, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

  • Strong Engineering Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and clean coding principles. You can take a complex logic problem and break it down into small, solvable pieces. You understand the challenges with building and operating reliable, high throughput services

  • Adaptability: You have a good foundation in backend development and server-side systems. Our stack relies on C#/.NET Core, Cassandra, gRPC, and Kubernetes. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of them today, but we expect you to be willing to jump in and learn whatever tool gets the job done.

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that's why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL's growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.
